info.name: MediBook API (demo)
info.description: Demo collection. Start MySQL and Redis, then npm start and npm run worker. Set the baseUrl collection variable if your port is not 3011. Run each folder top to bottom.

item.name: 1. Patients (CRUD)
item.description: Create, read, update, delete patients, plus validation and conflict errors.

exec: pm.test('Returns the new patient and a Location header', () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.response.to.have.header('Location'); });

request.description: Create returns 201 with the new record and a Location header.
Validation gives 400 with a meaningful message.
The UNIQUE constraint on email surfaces as 409.
The foreign key blocks deleting a patient with appointments.

item.name: 2. Doctors (CRUD)
item.description: Create, read, update, delete doctors, plus validation and conflict errors.

request.description: This doctor has no appointments, so they show up with zeros in the doctors report.

item.name: Create with fee as a string
3. Booking and cancelling
item.description: Run in order. Creates a demo doctor and books on a random future day, so it can be repeated.

exec: pm.test('Booked at the doctor fee', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('booked'); pm.expect(body.amount_paid).to.eql(80); });

request.description: The amount paid is taken from the doctor fee on the server.
Slot taken: 409 plus a waitlist offer.

exec: pm.test('Refund is 100% and computed by the server', () => { pm.expect(body.refund_percent).to.eql(100); pm.expect(body.refund_amount).to.eql(body.appointment.amount_paid); });

request.description: The response states the refund. The row is kept for refund history.
A cancelled slot is bookable again, because active_slot is NULL for cancelled rows.

item.name: 4. Waitlist and worker
item.description: Needs the worker running (npm run worker). Run in order. Uses the demo doctor from folder 3.

item.name: Setup: fill a whole day (12 bookings)

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ patient_id: (i % 5) + 1, doctor_id: doctorId, appt_datetime: randomDay + ' ' + slots[i] }) },
if (err || res.code !== 201) { console.error('Booking ' + i + ' failed', err || res.text()); } else { ids.push(res.json().id); }
pm.test('12 appointments were booked for the day', () => pm.expect(ids).to.have.length(12));

request.description: Books all 12 slots for one doctor-day, so the day is at the daily cap.

exec: pm.test('Day is full and the waitlist is offered', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.error).to.include('fully booked'); pm.expect(b.waitlist_available).to.eql(true); });

request.description: The 12-per-day cap, with a waitlist offer.

exec: pm.test('Two patients, in order', () => { const q = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(q.map((e) => e.patient_id)).to.eql([3, 4]); });

item.name: Cancel one booking to free a slot

request.description: This queues a promotion job. Watch the worker terminal.

item.name: View the queue after the worker ran

exec: setTimeout(() => {}, 2500); // give the worker a moment to promote
pm.test('Patient 3 was promoted; patient 4 is now first', () => { const q = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(q).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(q[0].patient_id).to.eql(4); });

request.description: If this fails, the worker is not running.

item.name: 5. Statistics and reports
item.description: Advanced SQL: joins, aggregates, HAVING, recursive CTE.

exec: pm.test('Includes a doctor with zero appointments', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some((d) => d.total_appointments === 0 && d.revenue_collected === 0)).to.eql(true));

request.description: LEFT JOIN keeps doctors who have no appointments.

exec: pm.test('Every row is above 80% utilization', () => pm.response.json().forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.utilization_percent).to.be.above(80)));

request.description: Doctor-days with more than 80% of the 12-slot capacity booked.

exec: pm.test('Has revenue, upcoming count, 7 days and utilization', () => { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('revenue_collected'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('upcoming_appointments'); pm.expect(b.next_days).to.have.length(7); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('utilization_percent'); });
